finding: On Instagram, video that opens on one named, concrete AI thing (a product, a deal, a song, a refund) and then follows the money or the surprise holds people longest and earns the shares; abstract framing does not.

evidence.result: Instagram video median exposure 116 against 25 for carousels; 9 of 10 organic shares. Watch: Higgsfield 44.6 s, Disney and Character.AI 39.7 s, UK number two 28.5 s with 4 shares, refund bot 24.9 s; Claude Duet 124 interactions per 1,000 with 4 shares; abstract "two passports" 17.5 s and no shares.

revisit_when: Compare this week's Instagram videos that open on a named thing with those that do not, on watch time and shares.
